raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`/openapi.json` exposes empty success schemas and no SSE contract for `/v1/chat/completions` and `/v1/completions`. It also advertises 422 although application request validation returns 400.

## Modifications

Reuse native unary/chunk/error models through FastAPI. Publish parsed SSE event schemas, following the OpenAPI 3.1 convention in vllm-project/vllm#60926. Preserve native serialization; add registered CPU tests and documentation. Related #32436 adds a static specification; this change improves the live export.

### Before / after

Captured through the production ASGI app without lifespan or inference, against base `5569b14d26ff`. These excerpts select HTTP 200 content; model definitions and descriptive text are omitted.

Before, both endpoints:

```yaml
application/json:
  schema: {}
# text/event-stream absent
```

After, chat completions:

```yaml
application/json:
  schema:
    $ref: '#/components/schemas/ChatCompletionResponse'
text/event-stream:
  schema:
    type: object
    required: [data]
    properties:
      data:
        type: string
        anyOf:
          - const: '[DONE]'
          - contentMediaType: application/json
            contentSchema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/ChatCompletionStreamResponse'
          - contentMediaType: application/json
            contentSchema:
              type: object
              required: [error]
              properties:
                error:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
      event: {type: string}
      id: {type: string}
      retry: {type: integer, minimum: 0}
```

For `/v1/completions`, the refs are `CompletionResponse` and `CompletionStreamResponse`. Both chunk models and dependencies are included in `components.schemas`.

| Error declarations | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Request validation | 422 / HTTPValidationError | 400 / ErrorResponse |
| Handled serving failure | Absent | 500 / ErrorResponse |
| Other errors | Unspecified | Default response, body unspecified |

SSE `schema` describes **one parsed event**, not the raw HTTP body. Consumers must parse SSE, handle `[DONE]`, then decode JSON and explicitly validate `contentSchema`; ordinary JSON Schema validation does not enforce these annotations. OpenAPI stays 3.1.0, without 3.2 `itemSchema`.

## Accuracy Tests

12 focused CPU tests passed:

```bash
python test/registered/unit/entrypoints/test_http_server_openapi.py -v
```

Covers native payload refs, real request validation, serialization/stream passthrough, decoded chunk/error validation, malformed payload rejection, SSE comments/multiline fixtures, caching and export disablement. Serving results are mocked. Both request declarations, 217 existing components and 81 other paths are unchanged; reachable refs resolve.

Changed-file pre-commit and documentation build/basic link checks passed. The isolated environment used Python 3.12.3, FastAPI 0.136.3, Pydantic 2.13.5, OpenAI 2.6.1 and Torch 2.14.0 (source pin: 2.14.1). No clean full-install, model accuracy, inference or hosted CI claim. Tests apply to the recorded base; newer upstream changes have not been incorporated.

Full-repository pre-commit passed all non-Rust hooks; Rust formatting/clippy checks were blocked by unavailable cargo/rustup. Mintlify 4.2.559 `broken-links --check-anchors --check-redirects` passed.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not run: no model, kernel or generation code changed; no performance claim.

## Checklist

- [ ] Format code according to the [pre-commit guide](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit). Scoped checks passed; see full-check qualification above.
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [unit-test guide](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to the [documentation guide](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmarks: not applicable to this declaration change.
- [x] Follow SGLang code style guidance.

## Review and Merge Process

Follow the repository's Merge Oncall, CODEOWNERS and CI process. Review and hosted CI are pending.

AI assistance: OpenAI Codex assisted with implementation and ran the reported checks; these are agent-run results.

+"""Response declarations for the Python server's OpenAI completion routes."""
+
+from typing import Any
+
+from pydantic import BaseModel
+
+from sglang.srt.entrypoints.openai.protocol import ErrorResponse
+
+
+def _sse_event_schema(stream_model: type[BaseModel]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Describe one parsed SSE event referencing an independently registered model.
+
+    This OpenAPI 3.1 convention describes a parsed event, not the complete HTTP
+    body. Consumers must decode JSON data and validate contentSchema explicitly;
+    ordinary JSON Schema validation treats contentSchema as an annotation.
+    """
+    return {
+        "type": "object",
+        "description": (
+            "One parsed SSE data event, not the complete stream. OpenAPI 3.1 "
+            "publishes this per-event convention under schema, not itemSchema. "
+            "Decode JSON data and validate its contentSchema explicitly. "
+            "The generator ends with data: [DONE]; a disconnected stream may "
+            "end earlier. Comment-only frames are not data events."
+        ),
+        "required": ["data"],
+        "properties": {
+            "data": {
+                "type": "string",
+                "anyOf": [
+                    {"const": "[DONE]"},
+                    {
+                        "contentMediaType": "application/json",
+                        "contentSchema": {
+                            "$ref": f"#/components/schemas/{stream_model.__name__}"
+                        },
+                    },
+                    {
+                        "contentMediaType": "application/json",
+                        "contentSchema": {
+                            "type": "object",
+                            "required": ["error"],
+                            "properties": {
+                                "error": {"$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"}
+                            },
+                        },
+                    },
+                ],
+            },
+            "event": {"type": "string"},
+            "id": {"type": "string"},
+            "retry": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 0},
+        },
+    }
+
+
+def completion_response_kwargs(
+    response_model: type[BaseModel], stream_model: type[BaseModel]
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Build route kwargs registering native unary, chunk and error schemas.
+
+    Supply the native models used by the completion serving layer. Callers must
+    return already serialized Response objects (including StreamingResponse),
+    as these routes do through model_json_response, to bypass response_model
+    validation and preserve native serialization. SSE describes parsed events
+    using the OpenAPI 3.1 convention documented by _sse_event_schema.
+    Other errors remain unspecified because middleware can use different bodies.
+    """
+    return {
+        "response_model": response_model,
+        "responses": {
+            200: {
+                # FastAPI registers this model and its dependencies, but also
+                # assigns it to JSON; openapi_extra restores the unary reference.
+                "model": stream_model,
+                "description": "A JSON completion, or SSE data events when stream=true.",
+                "content": {
+                    "text/event-stream": {"schema": _sse_event_schema(stream_model)}
+                },
+            },
+            400: {
+                "model": ErrorResponse,
+                "description": "Invalid request, including body validation failures.",
+            },
+            500: {
+                "model": ErrorResponse,
+                "description": "Internal error handled by the OpenAI serving layer.",
+            },
+            # FastAPI omits its automatic 422 when a default response is declared.
+            # These routes' RequestValidationError handler actually returns 400.
+            "default": {
+                "description": (
+                    "Other responses, including configuration-dependent errors such "
+                    "as authentication failures. Their bodies are not specified here."
+                ),
+            },
+        },
+        "openapi_extra": {
+            "responses": {
+                "200": {
+                    "content": {
+                        "application/json": {
+                            "schema": {
+                                "$ref": f"#/components/schemas/{response_model.__name__}"
+                            }
+                        }
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+        },
+    }

@@ -0,0 +1,415 @@
+"""Exercise production OpenAPI routes without lifespan, model loading, or inference."""
+
+import json
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import AsyncMock, patch
+
+from fastapi.responses import ORJSONResponse, StreamingResponse
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator, ValidationError
+
+from sglang.srt.entrypoints.http_server import app
+from sglang.srt.entrypoints.openai.protocol import (
+    ChatCompletionResponse,
+    ChatCompletionResponseChoice,
+    ChatCompletionResponseStreamChoice,
+    ChatCompletionStreamResponse,
+    ChatMessage,
+    CompletionResponse,
+    CompletionResponseChoice,
+    CompletionResponseStreamChoice,
+    CompletionStreamResponse,
+    DeltaMessage,
+    ErrorResponse,
+    SglExt,
+    UsageInfo,
+)
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=30, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+ROUTES = (
+    (
+        "/v1/chat/completions",
+        "openai_serving_chat",
+        {"messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}]},
+        ChatCompletionResponse,
+        ChatCompletionStreamResponse,
+    ),
+    (
+        "/v1/completions",
+        "openai_serving_completion",
+        {"prompt": "Hello"},
+        CompletionResponse,
+        CompletionStreamResponse,
+    ),
+)
+
+
+class TestCompletionOpenAPI(CustomTestCase):
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        """Read the actual app's schema without entering its serving lifespan."""
+        super().setUpClass()
+        cls.client = TestClient(app)
+        cls.addClassCleanup(cls.client.close)
+        response = cls.client.get("/openapi.json")
+        response.raise_for_status()
+        cls.schema = response.json()
+
+    def _validate_payload(self, payload, response_schema):
+        """Validate a wire payload with the published schema and its components."""
+        Draft202012Validator(
+            {**response_schema, "components": self.schema["components"]}
+        ).validate(payload)
+
+    def test_unary_models_and_extensions_are_declared(self):
+        """Both JSON success contracts expose native usage and extension fields."""
+        for path, _, _, model, _ in ROUTES:
+            with self.subTest(path=path):
+                responses = self.schema["paths"][path]["post"]["responses"]
+                root = responses["200"]["content"]["application/json"]["schema"]
+                self.assertEqual(root["$ref"], f"#/components/schemas/{model.__name__}")
+                properties = self.schema["components"]["schemas"][model.__name__][
+                    "properties"
+                ]
+                self.assertIn("usage", properties)
+                self.assertIn("sglext", properties)
+
+    def test_validation_status_and_other_errors(self):
+        """Declare the native errors without promising one body for all failures."""
+        for path, *_ in ROUTES:
+            with self.subTest(path=path):
+                responses = self.schema["paths"][path]["post"]["responses"]
+                self.assertNotIn("422", responses)
+                for status in ("400", "500"):
+                    self.assertEqual(
+                        responses[status]["content"]["application/json"]["schema"][
+                            "$ref"
+                        ],
+                        "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse",
+                    )
+                self.assertNotIn("content", responses["default"])
+
+    def _event_schema(self, path):
+        """Return the published parsed-event schema for a target route."""
+        return self.schema["paths"][path]["post"]["responses"]["200"]["content"][
+            "text/event-stream"
+        ]["schema"]
+
+    def _validate_event(self, path, event):
+        """Validate a parsed event and explicitly check its decoded JSON content.
+
+        Recognize the declared sentinel before JSON decoding. Raise ValueError
+        for malformed JSON or ValidationError if no contentSchema accepts it;
+        ordinary JSON Schema validation alone ignores contentSchema annotations.
+        """
+        schema = self._event_schema(path)
+        self._validate_payload(event, schema)
+        alternatives = schema["properties"]["data"]["anyOf"]
+        data = event["data"]
+        if any(data == branch.get("const") for branch in alternatives):
+            return
+        payload = json.loads(data)
+        for branch in alternatives:
+            if "contentSchema" not in branch:
+                continue
+            self.assertEqual(branch["contentMediaType"], "application/json")
+            try:
+                self._validate_payload(payload, branch["contentSchema"])
+                return
+            except ValidationError:
+                pass
+        raise ValidationError("Decoded SSE data matches no declared contentSchema")
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _parse_fixture_events(wire):
+        """Parse data-only UTF-8 test frames, joining data lines and ignoring comments.
+
+        This fixture parser accepts CRLF/LF framing and discards an unfinished
+        final frame. It is not a general SSE client or an event-order validator.
+        """
+        events = []
+        data = []
+        for line in wire.decode().replace("\r\n", "\n").splitlines():
+            if not line:
+                if data:
+                    events.append({"data": "\n".join(data)})
+                data = []
+            elif line.startswith("data:"):
+                value = line[5:]
+                data.append(value[1:] if value.startswith(" ") else value)
+        return events
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _chunk(model, with_usage=False):
+        """Build a native chunk fixture, optionally including usage and extensions."""
+        choice = (
+            ChatCompletionResponseStreamChoice(
+                index=0, delta=DeltaMessage(content="Hello")
+            )
+            if model is ChatCompletionStreamResponse
+            else CompletionResponseStreamChoice(index=0, text="Hello")
+        )
+        return model(
+            id="stream-test",
+            model="test-model",
+            created=1,
+            choices=[choice],
+            usage=UsageInfo(prompt_tokens=1, completion_tokens=1, total_tokens=2)
+            if with_usage
+            else None,
+            sglext=SglExt(input_ids=[1]) if with_usage else None,
+        )
+
+    def test_sse_references_native_payloads(self):
+        """Expose native chunk refs and nested errors using the 3.1 event convention."""
+        self.assertEqual(self.schema["openapi"], "3.1.0")
+        for path, _, _, _, chunk_model in ROUTES:
+            with self.subTest(path=path):
+                media = self.schema["paths"][path]["post"]["responses"]["200"][
+                    "content"
+                ]["text/event-stream"]
+                self.assertNotIn("itemSchema", media)
+                schema = media["schema"]
+                self.assertEqual(schema["type"], "object")
+                self.assertEqual(schema["required"], ["data"])
+                branches = schema["properties"]["data"]["anyOf"]
+                self.assertEqual(branches[0], {"const": "[DONE]"})
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    branches[1]["contentSchema"],
+                    {"$ref": f"#/components/schemas/{chunk_model.__name__}"},
+                )
+                error_schema = branches[2]["contentSchema"]
+                self.assertEqual(error_schema["required"], ["error"])
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    error_schema["properties"]["error"],
+                    {"$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"},
+                )
+                properties = self.schema["components"]["schemas"][chunk_model.__name__][
+                    "properties"
+                ]
+                self.assertIn("choices", properties)
+                self.assertIn("usage", properties)
+                self.assertIn("sglext", properties)
+
+    def test_sse_rejects_invalid_decoded_payloads(self):
+        """Reject bad JSON, malformed chunks/errors, flat errors and false sentinels."""
+        for path, _, _, _, model in ROUTES:
+            chunk = json.loads(self._chunk(model).model_dump_json())
+            wrong_choices = {**chunk, "choices": "not an array"}
+            wrong_choice = {**chunk, "choices": [17]}
+            missing_choices = {

+    def test_reachable_references_resolve(self):
+        """Resolve every reference reachable from either target operation."""
+        pending = [self.schema["paths"][path]["post"] for path, *_ in ROUTES]
+        visited = set()
+        while pending:
+            node = pending.pop()
+            if isinstance(node, list):
+                pending.extend(node)
+            elif isinstance(node, dict):
+                pending.extend(node.values())
+                reference = node.get("$ref")
+                if reference is not None and reference not in visited:
+                    self.assertTrue(reference.startswith("#/"), reference)
+                    visited.add(reference)
+                    target = self.schema
+                    for part in reference[2:].split("/"):
+                        target = target[part.replace("~1", "/").replace("~0", "~")]
+                    pending.append(target)

+    def test_stream_bytes_and_decoded_payloads(self):
+        """Preserve real-route SSE bytes and validate parsed native fixtures.
+
+        Serving results are mocked; comments and multiline data exercise the
+        fixture parser, not model generation, timing, ordering or disconnects.
+        """
+        self.assertEqual(self._parse_fixture_events(b"data: unfinished\n"), [])
+        for path, service, request, _, chunk_model in ROUTES:
+            with self.subTest(path=path):
+                plain = self._chunk(chunk_model)
+                extended = self._chunk(chunk_model, with_usage=True)
+                error = ErrorResponse(message="Test error", type="TestError", code=400)
+                multiline = json.dumps(json.loads(extended.model_dump_json()), indent=2)
+                wire = (
+                    ": keep-alive\r\n\r\n"
+                    f"data: {plain.model_dump_json()}\r\n\r\n"
+                    + "".join(f"data: {line}\n" for line in multiline.splitlines())
+                    + "\n"
+                    + f"data: {json.dumps({'error': error.model_dump()})}\n\n"
+                    + "data: [DONE]\n\n"
+                ).encode()
+                result = StreamingResponse(
+                    iter([wire[:11], wire[11:]]), media_type="text/event-stream"
+                )
+                serving = SimpleNamespace(handle_request=AsyncMock(return_value=result))
+                with patch.object(app.state, service, serving, create=True):
+                    response = self.client.post(path, json={**request, "stream": True})
+                self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
+                self.assertTrue(
+                    response.headers["content-type"].startswith("text/event-stream")
+                )
+                self.assertEqual(response.content, wire)
+                events = self._parse_fixture_events(response.content)
+                self.assertEqual(len(events), 4)
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    json.loads(events[0]["data"]), json.loads(plain.model_dump_json())
+                )
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    json.loads(events[1]["data"]),
+                    json.loads(extended.model_dump_json()),
+                )
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    json.loads(events[2]["data"]), {"error": error.model_dump()}
+                )
+                self.assertEqual(events[3], {"data": "[DONE]"})
+                for event in events:
+                    self._validate_event(path, event)
